notes:
Summary:
- Small team (core devs 18) building a JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that provides multi-model code completions and context-aware refactors.
- Primary differentiator: local project indexing + on-device snippet cache + optional cloud inference. Want Redwood as backend for managed model variants and fallbacks.
Recent timeline:
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (A. Patel) — product overview, high-level pricing ask. Customer wants SLA for monthly active devs.
- 2026-02-25: Technical deep-dive (Ethan R., infra) — discussed VPC/private control plane, KMS integration, audit logs. Fireflies: ff-1329-jetplugin-demo.
- 2026-03-03: Security sync with SRE (Maya, Ethan) — customer needs SOC2 + evidence of data residency. Fireflies: ff-1355-security-sync.
- 2026-03-10: POC scoping call — agreed on 2-week POC: run Redwood Private in their GCP VPC (shared subnet), test local-index + streaming completions, measure cold-start and tail latency. Gmail thread gr-9876543210.
Use-case & requirements (explicit):
- Workload: interactive code completion and chat-like assistant inside IDE. Heavy emphasis on streaming token-by-token responses to keep completion latency under ~80ms per token.
- Throughput: expect ~250 active devs in POC ramp, ~2k concurrent autocompletion sessions at scale.
- Local indexing: plugin maintains a local project index (user files + workspace symbols). Need prefix-KV caching to reduce tokenization + model context size. Optionally upload embeddings for cross-repo search to private cluster (customer insists on residency).
- Model needs: prefer open models with quantized variants; must support model-version pinning and deterministic rollbacks during canary. Need small LMs for first-line completions and larger LLMs for complex refactors. Fallback policy required when dedicated pool saturated.
- Latency SLOs: median 40ms token latency for short completions, 99th <200ms. Cold-start for large model <600ms.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — will accept higher cost for accuracy but want Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization.
- Security: SSO/SAML for admin, KMS for key control, audit logging at token/request level, 90-day retention by default, ability to set EU-only residency for EU customers.
POC success criteria:
- Streaming integration demonstrably reduces perceived completion latency in IntelliJ (measured via plugin telemetry).
- Local index + KV cache cuts model context size by >=30% on sample project.
- Model pinning + canary rollback works end-to-end from Console.
- No blocking security findings from customer's InfoSec during POC.
Notes from customer (quotes):
- "We need completions to feel instantaneous — even if models are large, streaming must be smooth."
- "If Redwood can prove safe, we can fold into paid plan for customers paying enterprise plugin support."
Open action items / blockers:
- Provide architecture diagram for Private deployment in GCP VPC + KMS flow (requested by 2026-03-14). Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1codestitch-deck.
- Security to produce SOC2 artifact and data residency proof.
- Engineering to prepare a prebuilt on-prem package for offline customers (packaging checklist pending).
Next steps:
- Schedule POC kickoff (owner: Maya).
- Send POC playbook + infra checklist to Codestitch by 2026-03-15.
- Deliver preliminary quantization/latency suggestion from Redwood Optimize team (EOD 2026-03-18).
Misc CRM notes:
- Pricing interest: commit-level for Dedicated or annual Private license. Rough ARR target band $50k–$200k.
- Competitor sensitivity: already evaluating Tabnine Enterprise; key win criteria = data residency + better streaming latency.
